corrected_code = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if base not in row]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(width) if all(grid[r][c] != base for r in range(height))]

    line_cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
                  if (r in row_lines or c in col_lines)
                  and not (r in row_lines and c in col_lines)]
    line_color = Counter(line_cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color != line_color and all(v == color for v in corners) else base)
        out.append(row)

    colored = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != base]
    if not colored:
        return [[base]]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in colored); r1 = max(r for r, _ in colored)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in colored); c1 = max(c for _, c in colored)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
